overallNotes: Independent blinded review of all 79 unique items, four contrast sets and eight cross-scenario repetition sets. One quiet item received safety-only null scores and was safe. Most substantive meanings are supported, including categorical statements retained from source copy and calculated future exact dates; five items have specific added or strengthened meaning findings. No biography, raw natal-origin claims, invented unsupplied joint premise, or suppression breach was identified. The main editorial limitations are source-block assembly, repeated stock scenes/window wording, weak warm/clinical wrappers, and copied lenses whose paragraph placement does not establish application. Two contrast sets have distinct N1-supported practical choices; two compare identical meanings and appropriately offer no invented difference. Grounding, meaningful use, and cross-scenario repetition were assessed separately. Source assignments, generation identities, prior verdicts and the other review remained unseen; reviewer model diversity is unestablished.
